signature.name: VTask.codRestrict
signature.type: {L : FirstOrder.Language} -> {M : Type w} -> {N : Type u_1} -> [L.Structure M] -> [L.Structure N] -> (p : L.Substructure N) -> (f : L.Hom M N) -> (h : ∀ (c : M), f c ∈ p) -> L.Hom M ↥p

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a total construction with no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for every homomorphism f and proof h that the image lies in p.
